items.title: 3 Stocks to Watch as Coinbase and Trading Platforms Face a Volatility Test

That mix of frothy enthusiasm and risk-off selling often reshapes where trading volume and hedging demand go. This piece walks through three stocks that appear closely tied to this surge in volatility, and explains why their reaction to the Anthropic listing might matter to you.
